label: Multi-platform writer
intro: I write and strategize for experiences on every medium (and lately, I lead). Today that’s the UX Writer Hub at Telkom Indonesia.
about: I was born when David Bowie and Mick Jagger’s “Dancing in the Street” topped the UK chart, and I gave up drawing after a year of kindergarten. Words stuck. I wrote ads, TV scripts and the odd song before I took the leap to UX writing. Whoever I write for, I try to see through their eyes (yes, even a toddler’s).
portraitAlt: Purna smiling by an office window, in a hoodie with Elmo on it
contactText: Write to me about a full-time role, remote freelance work or a talk (or ask where to find the best fried rice in Jakarta).
